name: How do I choose the right heights for my multi-level countertop?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right heights for my multi-level countertop?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right heights involves considering the primary uses for each section. Standard counter height is typically 36 inches, ideal for food preparation. Bar-height sections are often 42 inches, suitable for bar stools. Lower sections, sometimes around 30 inches, can be ergonomic for baking or as a desk area. We recommend considering the heights of the primary users and the specific tasks to be performed at each level to ensure maximum comfort and utility for your household.
acceptedAnswer.description: Select heights based on intended use (e.g., 36" for prep, 42" for bar seating, 30" for baking), and user comfort.
